text:
Olga V: quick design sync  chart axis unit + outlier handling. should y-axis use `/s` or `req/s`? panels are cramped when p95 overlays show labels.
Ben H: `/s` on axis, tooltip shows full 'Requests per second (req/s)'. short on-axis, readable on hover.
Ishaan R: agree. also legend height spikes when smoothing is on because raw+smoothed both appear. suggestion: show smoothed as primary, collapse raw into a muted, single-line item with a 'Show raw' action.
Tom S: accessibility: collapsed items must be reachable via keyboard and announce state with aria-expanded and a clear label like 'Raw series collapsed'.
Olga V: product asked for "reduce noise" toggle. two options: percentile clip (changes scale) or visual fade (alpha/stroke change). thoughts?
Ben H: visual fade preferred. clipping can mislead and hide real incidents. fading keeps hover/inspect behavior intact.
Ishaan R: microcopy: label 'De-emphasize outliers' helper 'Fade isolated spikes visually; values unchanged.' short enough for compact panels.
A11yBot: Reminder: don't rely on color/opacity alone. Add aria-live announce 'Outlier de-emphasis enabled' and a textual caption line when enabled. Ensure faded points remain focusable and meet contrast when focused.
Tom S: small CSS example for collapsed legend:
```.legend-item--muted { color: #8b9096; font-size:12px; }
.legend-item--muted:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); }
```
Ishaan R: keyboard flow: press 'L' to focus legend, arrows to navigate, Enter toggles raw. Add to shortcuts modal.
Olga V: I'll implement prop `deEmphasizeOutliers` and feature flag `console.featureFlags.outlierFade`. will include aria strings and tooltip copy.
Ben H: tiny tooltip copy nit: use sentence case 'Requests per second (req/s)'.
Olga V: will post figma link and open PR; pinging beta teams once ready.
